# Rohan Hospital & Rohan Fertility (IVF) Centre, Karimnagar

> Fertility (IVF) centre and women's hospital in Karimnagar, Telangana, India, led by Dr. Anamalla Sridevi Naresh (Dr. Sridevi Naresh), fertility (IVF) specialist, gynaecologist and obstetrician. Rated 4.4/5 from 169 Google reviews (October 2026).

## Dr. Anamalla Sridevi Naresh
- Also known as: Dr. Sridevi Naresh, Dr. Sridevi Anamalla, Dr. A. Sridevi
- Role: Clinical Director, Fertility (IVF) Specialist, Gynaecologist & Obstetrician, Rohan Hospital & Rohan Fertility (IVF) Centre, Karimnagar
- Qualifications: MBBS; DGO (Diploma in Obstetrics & Gynaecology); Master of Reproductive Medicine (MRM), Homerton University, London, UK
- Training: Accredited hands-on IVF training at Cleveland Clinic, USA; accredited IVF workshops and training
- Special interests: infertility, IVF, ICSI, IUI, PCOS/PCOD, adenomyosis, endometriosis, uterine fibroids and fibroid ablation, high-risk pregnancy, pregnancy and delivery care, painless delivery, laparoscopy and hysteroscopy, menopause care
- Patients describe her as calm, approachable and reassuring, and say she "listens carefully and always gives genuine suggestions".

## Services
- Fertility: IVF, ICSI, IUI, follicular monitoring, semen analysis, tubal recanalization, testicular biopsy, in-house IVF & ICSI lab
- Gynaecological surgery: diagnostic laparoscopy & hysteroscopy, LAVH, myomectomy, microwave ablation for adenomyosis, hysteroscopic polypectomy
- Obstetrics: 24/7 maternity care, painless (epidural) delivery, normal delivery & LSCS, high-risk pregnancy, ICU
- Diagnostics: TVS, 3D TVS, Tiffa (anomaly) scan, NT scan, Doppler, follicular study, 24x7 laboratory
- Speciality clinics: female and male infertility, puberty clinic, menopause clinic, PCOS/PCOD clinic

## Facilities
- IVF & ICSI lab with egg, sperm and embryo banking; egg and sperm freezing
- Medical and surgical ICUs, ventilators, CPAP, defibrillators, infusion pumps
- Voluson S8 3D ultrasound, ECG, 2D echo, X-ray, CTG
- A/c normal delivery suite, newborn baby warmers, 24-hour laboratory
- Special, deluxe and suite rooms; cashless insurance and state government reimbursement

## Fertility insights (on the website)
- When to see a fertility specialist (under 35: after 12 months of trying; 35+: after 6 months; 40+: right away)
- IUI vs IVF vs ICSI explained
- What to expect during an IVF cycle, step by step
- PCOS and fertility
- AMH (ovarian reserve) and semen analysis
- Fibroids, adenomyosis, endometriosis and fertility
- Lifestyle tips and common fertility myths

## Fees (INR)
- OP specialist consultation: ₹500
- Super specialist consultation: ₹1,000
- Rooms per day: Special ₹2,000; A/c Deluxe ₹3,500; A/c Suite ₹5,000; ICU ₹5,000
